facts.rider-wreath: A man with a laurel wreath on his head rides a white horse toward the right.
facts.wand-wreath: A laurel wreath tied with a red ribbon hangs on the tip of the wand in his hand.
facts.crowd: At the lower left, people on foot keep pace beside him, holding wands upright (six wands in all).
facts.caparison: The horse wears a patterned green cloth and a red bridle.
facts.cloak: The man wears a reddish-purple cloak.
facts.blue-sky: The background is a blue sky.

glosses.rider-wreath: Confidence earned by one's own effort.

reversedGloss.blocked: There is a result, but recognition and news are late.
reversedGloss.internalized: A time when acknowledging yourself comes before applause from outside.

misdescriptions.wrong: The people are pointing their wands at him.
